repairNotes:
I rebuilt both eyes in ILLUSTRATION.svg and in the SVG inside index.html; the eye code is now identical in the two files and the XML parses. I haven't rendered anything, so the eye crops at full and card size, and how the gaze looks while it moves, still need your QA.

**Why the eyes looked wrong.** The far eye's opening was only about 35×25 against the near eye's 79×42, which made it look pinched. Its iris was clipped into a dark blob with extra tiny highlights. Both pupils also sat inside wrapper groups carrying arbitrary 5 px and 3 px offsets that didn't line up with the eye masks.

**Near eye.** The eye shape, its mask and the white of the eye now come from one shared outline (about 80×42). The upper lid's inner edge sits just inside that outline, so it overlaps the top of the iris. I kept the outer lash flicks and the lower-lid accent. Inside, there is one iris with a little tone in its lower half, one pupil and one main highlight. The tiny second highlight is gone.

**Far eye.** It is narrower for the three-quarter view, but the opening is taller now (about 37×30), so it reads as the same open, alert expression rather than a squint. Again the mask, white of the eye and lid share one outline. I added a new upper-lid line, an outer lash flick and a thin lower-lid line. The iris is simplified for card size: a narrower oval, a pupil and one highlight, with no screentone.

**Shared gaze.** I removed the unrelated offsets. Both irises are now placed directly in their final up-right position, toward the idea star, at the same relative spot in each eye: about a quarter of the way toward the inner corner and slightly up. The iris, pupil and highlight move together as one piece inside each eye's mask.

**Animation.** Only the starting values of the two gaze moves changed, so both eyes start looking down-left by matching amounts. The near eye now starts 8 px left and 4 px down. The far eye starts 4.5 px left and 4 px down, a smaller sideways move because of the angle. The timing is unchanged (0.3–0.7 s), with no blink added.

**Checked on paper only.** Working from the coordinates, the irises stay inside their masks with the upper lid overlapping them at the starting position, at the final position and in between.

Brows, hair, the four panels, all wording, the two colours, the layer order and every other animation are unchanged.
